parsed.post: Discarding my last run (0.994793) as it was slightly worse than my previous best (0.988277). It seems the combination of depth 6 and current LR/batch size is hitting a plateau or the stability was lost. I will try increasing DEPTH to 8 to see if capacity helps overcome this.
